name: TC-147: FIXED_ITEM without a menu item selection is rejected
description: Submitting an Item Discount coupon without picking a menu item is blocked and no coupon is created. Note: the app's own validateForm() has a menuItemId-required rule with a custom message, but it never gets a chance to run here — MUI's Select renders a hidden input[name=menuItemId][required] for native HTML5 form validation, and the browser's native 'Please fill out this field' constraint-validation UI intercepts the submit event before React's onSubmit fires (confirmed live: no POST /api/coupons request is ever sent).
